pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

experience: Multi-repo projects gained a way to add and remove repositories. Asked to add a repository that sits in the project folder, an agent must add it to the project, not edit .workler by hand or create a second project.
rule: t3_project_repositories: `add` takes a repository already in the project folder
prompt: I cloned acme/billing into the billing folder of my shop project. Add it to the shop multi-repo project in T3 Code.
notes: Guards the t3_project_repositories tool added for multi-repo projects (feature/multi-repo-surfaces).
